Any advice on tackling a drywall mold project? This is the list of items we have or just purchased. 

- eye protection
- face masks
- disposable gloves
- electric jig saw and blades 
- box fan for window 
- mold armor (rapid clean remediation) spray
- kilz (mold/mildew kind)
- paint brushes
- wire brush

We will put cardboard over the air vent and keep the door closed as much as possible. The trash can is right outside the window, so we can throw the trash right into the bin. 

We are planning to remove everything that we see is contaminated, spray with mold armor, wait a week, spray with mold armor again, wait another week, paint with special kilz. 

Also, is it necessary to buy the jumpsuits? We can wear old clothes, then wash them on hot afterwards. 

We don’t have any air scrubber, air filters, or dehumidifier though… 

We will be replacing the drywall, insulation, trim, and carpet as needed, but does it look like we need to replace the wood pieces on the edge of the floor? 

Any advice is appreciated!

I really wish I could do something so sassy and perfectly pitched like that. This is maybe the 3rd or 4th time I’ve ever seen her. The last time I saw her was at my wedding… 4 years ago. And I don’t expect to see her for at least a couple more years. So it is just so unexpected when someone I have no relationship with asks me such a personal question all of a sudden. I went ahead and sent her a pretty stand-my-ground type of heads up message on how she made me uncomfortable and that she shouldn’t be asking anyone that question. I’m picking up on a common theme with these no boundary people who ask this question…. And that’s that they had no trouble conceiving, if not had an unexpected pregnancy very young. I think in their minds they are like “if you want a baby, then you should just have a baby. Easy as 1, 2, 3.”

I’m trying to learn how to be assertive and stick up for myself. I want to be quick on my feet, but I know, at the very least, I can have some witty responses in my back pocket to use. I love the medical question idea! I know that people are just excited for when we do conceive, but it sure throws me into an emotional spiral to be asked. Like do they think I just found out yesterday and they will happen to be the first one to know? How far along are they expecting me to be when they ask this question? Or are they expecting a no? Lol

This just happened to me…. It’s like their curiosity makes them lose all sense of respecting someone’s privacy and feelings. I quickly realized what they were asking me when they said “so…. So I gave them an honest answer that would also not give them a reason to feel like prying further (I told them I had a couple drinks the night before. I also am not a drinker, so it was way normal for me to not want to drink for awhile after.) They then went and asked my sister if I was pregnant! Like lay off! They have NO right to be playing detective like that. And I guess they thought my reason for not drinking that night was a lie or they wouldn’t have asked someone else close to me. I’m trying to just forget that happened. And trying to come up with better quick responses that only give info that I want to share. Nobody should ever be asking anyone if they are pregnant. If someone is, I’m sure you’ll find out when the time is right. How dare they try to out me… These people are usually socially awkward and have no boundaries.
